title: Typed-room behavior manifest (per-type agent-behavior declaration)
description: The per-type declaration the behavior loop executes. Track 13 operating contract: an agent resolves this manifest from the TRUSTED PLATFORM REGISTRY by room type — never fetched-and-obeyed from room-supplied content (injection-safe). The manifest declares what the loop may auto-do (safe tier), what it may only propose (advance tier, expressed in the room's own verb grammar so the owner approves by replying with the verb), and how the type's data object is loaded and analyzed. A new room type = a new manifest, not new code paths.

entity.description: The primary entity the room manages (e.g. 'PipelineEntry', 'InboxItem').

state_model.description: The state-model shape — the framework's type discriminator.

data_object.description: Where the room's data object lives in its vault (prep_get/prep_put).

module.description: Repo-relative path of the skill module holding the attention primitive.

analyze.description: The type's analysis primitive (the detect half of the behavior loop).

autonomy_default.description: Default autonomy when the room's data object doesn't set one. 'full' is deliberately NOT a valid manifest value — advance-tier actions never auto-fire from a manifest.

cooldown_s.description: Minimum seconds between behavior posts to the same room.

reasons.description: Attention reasons that classify an item as safe-tier. An item auto-executes ONLY if ALL its reasons are in this set.

effect.description: Safe-tier actions are ADDITIVE by contract (append/fill, never move/close/delete).

hub_slug.description: Neon skill-catalog slug of the cloud tool.

tool.description: Optional Hub cloud-tool binding used to perform the action.

verbs.description: reason (or 'prefix*' or 'default') -> proposal template in the room's OWN verb grammar, '{name}' interpolated. The owner approves by replying with the verb; the type's existing command handler applies it — no bespoke approval machinery.
